text: No, the property did **not** lose tree cover in **2024**. The evidence shows a **0.7 ha** loss in **2023**, but no loss events in 2024—only small, non-event patches (<0.5 ha) totaling **0.7 ha** in that year. These minor changes are not classified as significant tree-cover loss. The **2023 loss (0.7 ha)** was the only corroborated event post-baseline.
